env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GOEXPERIMENT=

cd repro

# A type switch on a const view of a union value reads the dynamic
# type without writing through the view, so it must compile and run.
logos run .
stdout '^text$'
stdout '^text:x$'
stdout '^blob:b:1$'

-- repro/go.mod --
module example.com/repro57fault

go 1.27

-- repro/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type Value interface{ Text | Number }
type Text struct{ Text string }
type Number struct{ Number float64 }

func kind(v const Value) string {
	switch v.(type) {
	case Text:
		return "text"
	case Number:
		return "number"
	default:
		return "none"
	}
}

func kindBound(v const Value) string {
	switch u := v.(type) {
	case Text:
		return "text:" + u.Text
	case Number:
		return "number"
	default:
		return "none"
	}
}

type Blob struct {
	Name string
	Tags []string
}

type Shape interface{ Text | Blob }

func shapeName(s const Shape) string {
	switch u := s.(type) {
	case Text:
		return "text:" + u.Text
	case Blob:
		return "blob:" + u.Name + ":" + fmt.Sprint(len(u.Tags))
	default:
		return "none"
	}
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(kind(Text{Text: "x"}))
	fmt.Println(kindBound(Text{Text: "x"}))
	fmt.Println(shapeName(Blob{Name: "b", Tags: []string{"t"}}))
}
